description: Ore-Specific Risk Classification of Tailings Dams Stability: Linking Mineralogical Properties, Historical Failures, and Numerical Modeling is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Parsa Alizadeh. This dataset supports the study “Ore-Specific Risk Classification of Tailings Dams Stability: Linking Mineralogical Properties, Historical Failures, and Numerical Modeling.”. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
